svg.title: Veterinary nurse — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as veterinary nurse, wearing scrubs. Visible work cue: An animal paw has four separate toe pads above a partly unrolled bandage. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: long hair, a softly squared face and round glasses.
